test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two orientations of a dice are shown. This dice can be obtained by folding which of the option figures along the lines?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12ef27e9db06d7549588dca8c42d103acc8f5a293d50802dc5abc7015b52bc98.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/578845362723426d1c8adb393a2d813b08e9aa62fdc47d263f4dc791f244f30b.png] 

Option 1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a9a49c2934cb46b808542353866f27924d29305090f742531ba6ebebf13dece.png] → Here Roman numbers shown in both cubes are adjacent to each other so, **this dice can be obtained**.

Option 2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/757664d20fff08d74e4757b34bf6737c13ee10b267de0c7634f2b6d66f6cac9e.png] → Here Roman numbers VI, III should be adjacent to each other from given cubes so, this dice cannot be obtained.

Option 3) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfcc3460fb17da192fae2dfd8810e05a065e3e2f9e1bb048229afec4e343d05e.png] → Here Roman numbers I, V should be adjacent to each other from given cubes so, this dice cannot be obtained.

Option 4) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e6fc125cc11d8ca2b0e51e69b1f1d4b6f033a574854d9063ad4233ff82b3d25.png] → Here Roman numbers I, V should be adjacent to each other from given cubes so, this dice cannot be obtained.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
